title: A Survey on LLM-as-a-Judge

model.params_source: paper Sec. 4.4.1 'Model Configuration' (temperature 0; gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09); max_tokens assumed

task.subset_rule: all: 2,553 samples x 2 response orders = 5,106 rows built by the hook (gold = human label mapped to the presented order)
task.approximation: The exact meta-evaluation template is not singled out; the printed Gao et al. pairwise template is adapted from summaries to responses with a TIE option (resolution plan); a different template can move agreement by several points.

items.source: LLMEval2 benchmark (Zhang et al. 2023), LLMEval2_benchmark.json.zip linked from https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/DAMO-ConvAI/tree/main/WideDeep (Google Drive file 1sRbYZ0SWqmbIlzC_eB2zjyQF5TBynSXo)
items.config_or_split: all 2,553 samples (1,050 response-1 wins, 1,021 response-2 wins, 482 ties)
items.fields_verified: LLMEval2_benchmark.json (inside the zip; JSON lines, 2,553 records): dataset, query, response1, response2, human in {model1 1050, model2 1021, TIE 482}

placeholders.question: items.question (hook)
placeholders.response_1: items.response_1 (response1 in the '12' row, response2 in the '21' row)

prompt.source_location: Sec. 3 box 'Evaluation Prompt Templates from Gao et al. [38]', Pairwise Comparison; Sec. 4.4.1 (two-order prompting, Percentage Agreement)
prompt.verbatim: partial (printed template: 'Given a new article, which summary is better? Answer "Summary 0" or "Summary 1". You do not need to explain the reason. Article: {Article} Summary 0: {Summary_0} Summary 1: {Summary_1}'; article/summary slots renamed to question/response and a TIE option added per Sec. 4.4.1)

output.parse: hook: first case-insensitive mention of 'response 1' / 'response 2' / 'tie'; none -> invalid (excluded)
output.postprocess: strip; map back to the original response identity when the order was swapped; no match = invalid (excluded, as Table 3 counts only valid responses)

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: hook: Percentage Agreement = share of valid judgements equal to the human label (Response 1 / Response 2 / TIE in the presented order)
metric.original_location: Table 2, row GPT-4-turbo, column Alignment with Human (n=5106)

open_points: Approve the adapted pairwise template (question/response wording, TIE option): Sec. 4.4.1 names LLMEval2, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, temperature 0 and both response orders but does not print the judge prompt; the hook is complete and prepare verified (5,106 rows).
notes: bootstrap item = LLMEval2 sample (both orders paired). Table 3 reports the per-label alignment counts, useful for a secondary check. || [hooks_2 2026-09-07] LLMEval2 archive downloaded from Google Drive (1.4 MB), field names verified, two-order expansion in the hook; status stays needs_human only for the template approval.
hook: harness/tierb/hooks/W4404986534.py: load_items (Google Drive zip, both orders), render (adapted pairwise template), parse (label), score (agreement over valid judgements)
